422801.description: Fires a barrage of assault rifle shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

422802.description: Fires special bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

422803.name: Special Bombard
422803.description: Fires a volley of bombs, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The bombs can be intercepted.

422804.name: Plasma Laser I

422805.name: Plasma Laser II
422805.description: Fires an enhanced laser, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
